`solve_model` converts `n.snapshots`, not the snapshots stored in the model, and `_to_model` only flattens MultiIndexes when the model uses flat snapshots. For example, after building a flat investment-period model, replacing the network’s snapshots with a single-level datetime index causes the callback to receive that datetime index unchanged rather than the model’s flat tuple-labelled representation. Thus the guarantee does not hold for every network and call path.
